Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Norman Rose is credited on 93 distinct recordings across 6 programs from 1943-10-19 through 1979-10-01. Documented roles include performer on 66 recordings, host on 25 recordings, and narrator on 2 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are CBS Radio Mystery Theater (performer on 54 recordings; 54 distinct recordings), Dimension X (host on 25 recordings; 25 distinct recordings), X Minus One (performer on 4 recordings and narrator on 2 recordings; 6 distinct recordings), Theater Five (performer on 4 recordings; 4 distinct recordings), Words at War (performer on 3 recordings; 3 distinct recordings), and The Chase (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).
